beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some subjects need a whole book but attract only a small audience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That can make them uneconomic for a human author.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AI gives us a chance to fill that gap.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A book gives complex ideas room to develop and connect.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can follow an argument instead of rebuilding it through scattered answers.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Experts supply the questions, structure, and corrections.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Our AI systems use that guidance to develop books and new editions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers contribute by challenging claims and adding missing perspectives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each edition can build on what readers and experts have learned.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When you open a book, you reuse the thinking that shaped it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A good niche book gathers questions you might not know to ask.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: For depth, that can serve you better than starting another agent conversation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Instead of repeating the exploration, readers share one developed account.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That can reduce repeated AI computation, its energy use, and its cost.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This applies to fiction as well as technical subjects.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Science fiction can explore possibilities that mainstream markets leave aside.
